meta.description: A transaction-summary card with merchant info, amount, date, and tappable detail surface.

verdict.title: Keep — all findings resolved
verdict.text: Rebuilt on node 5488:32955 in the 2026 Working File. The type enum that packed five layouts into one axis is replaced by real Leading-Slot and Trailing-Slot nodes; the single state axis is split into State = Default | Pressed | Disabled beside Status = Default | Read | Skeleton per §6, so read-and-pressed is expressible; the heading weight matches Generic Card at Proxima Soft Bold 18/23; and pressed and disabled both ship. Naming is complete across every variant including the skeleton — no offset frames, no # sigil, no spaces, no duplicate names, and slots kebab-cased per §4. The label overflow is resolved, with the 270px LabelAmountRow budget honoured as 172 + 98. All four DS Health traits pass; the only item still open is Code Connect, blocked until the native library exists.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: A generic transaction row — the leading and trailing slots let it carry an avatar, an icon or nothing, so one component covers the layouts the old type enum needed five variants for.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Owns its surface, border and typography across all five states, and composes shared Avatar and Badge instances rather than redrawing them.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: State and Status are separate PascalCase properties with Title Case values per §1 and §5, following the §6 split. Layer naming is clean across all five variants including the skeleton: slots kebab-cased per §4, text layers on the §3 vocabulary, every frame named for what it holds, and no duplicates, sigils, spaces or offset frames left anywhere.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: leadingElement and trailingElement are both real Figma Slots, and the avatar, badge and trailing icon are all shared instances — the composition problem the previous assessment raised is solved.

behavior.notes: Label + badge + date + amount. The baseline transaction row.
Adds a 32 × 32 Avatar at the leading edge. Used for person-to-person transactions.
Replaces the badge with an overflow menu button (⋯). Used when a row has context-menu actions.
Swaps the amount for a trailing badge; swaps date for a reference number. Used for confirmations without monetary value.
Loading placeholder pattern. Worth documenting alongside Generic Card's skeleton as a DS-wide convention.
Rows typically drill into transaction detail — need pressed tint for tap feedback.

resolved.headline: type enum replaced by slot-based composition.
resolved.body: v2.0: Rebuilt on node 5488:32955 in the 2026 Working File. The axis that packed five structurally different layouts into one enum is gone — the leading and trailing positions are now real SLOT nodes, so an avatar, an icon or nothing at all is the consumer’s choice rather than a variant. The set drops from a layout enum to five states. This is the headline recommendation applied. (C2 · Property)

resolved.headline: no amount and more information values retired.
resolved.body: v2.0: Both described what was absent rather than what the card was for, and both are gone with the enum that carried them. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Heading weight aligned with Generic Card.
resolved.body: v2.0: The label is now Proxima Soft Bold 700 at 18/23, matching Generic Card’s Title exactly. The two cards sit next to each other in lists, so a Semibold/Bold split between them read as an error rather than a distinction. (C3)

resolved.headline: Pressed and disabled states added.
resolved.body: v2.0: state=pressed fills the surface #F6F9FD and state=disabled ships alongside it, closing the missing-states finding. The card is a primary tap target in transaction lists, so touch-down feedback was the most-felt gap. (C5)

resolved.headline: Axis split into State and Status.
resolved.body: v2.1: Verified on the live node. State = Default | Pressed | Disabled now sits beside Status = Default | Read | Skeleton, so interaction, content status and loading are three separate concerns rather than five values competing for one axis. Read-and-pressed is expressible, which in a transaction list is the common case. Both properties are PascalCase per §1 with Title Case values per §5, matching the split Generic Card made and the rule in §6. (C2 · Property)

resolved.headline: Slots brought onto the family convention.
resolved.body: v2.1: ⤷ leadingElement and ⤷ trailingElement are now Leading-Slot and Trailing-Slot — the literal arrow character is gone and both follow §4 kebab-case with the -Slot suffix used across Bottom Sheet, Alert and Generic Card. (C1 · Rename)

resolved.headline: The three offset frames named, and the typo fixed.
resolved.body: v2.1: offset → BadgeContainer, offset → AmountContainer, and the misspelled amout-offset → Amount. A new LabelAmountRow now holds the label and amount columns as an explicit 270px row — 172 + 98 — so the horizontal structure is declared rather than implied by position. (C1 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Legacy sigil dropped and frames moved to PascalCase.
resolved.body: v2.1: #label → Label, #date → Date, #amount → Amount, on the §3 vocabulary. The frames follow — container → CardContainer, content-container → ContentContainer, transaction-detail → TransactionDetail — and the space in leading element is closed as LeadingElement. (C1 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Label overflow resolved.
resolved.body: v2.2: Re-measured on the live node — Label (5488:32986) is now 172px, matching TransactionDetail exactly rather than running 33px past it. The LabelAmountRow budget of 270px is now honoured on both sides: 172 for the label column, 98 for the amount. Nothing overlaps, and a native implementation reading these bounds gets one consistent answer instead of two. (C4)

resolved.headline: Skeleton brought onto the shared vocabulary.
resolved.body: v2.2: The inner layers are renamed to match the default variant — transaction-detail → TransactionDetail, the last offset frame → BadgeContainer, and tag / header / badge → Tag / Header / Badge. No frame in the component is named offset any more, and the skeleton no longer needs a second vocabulary to read. (C1 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Amount duplication resolved.
resolved.body: v2.2: The trailing column now reads AmountRow → AmountContainer → Amount — three distinct names across three levels, with the text layer keeping the §3 vocabulary name and the wrappers describing what they hold. (C1 · Rename)

accessibility.ios: Whole row in Button; one accessibilityLabel combining label, badge, amount and date.
Pass the amount through the localized currency formatter, not the raw string.
.accessibilityValue("Read") when Status is Read — the grey amount alone is not announced.
Announce "Loading" once; .accessibilityHidden(true) on the placeholder bars.
accessibility.android: contentDescription = "Loading" on the skeleton container; placeholders cleared with clearAndSetSemantics.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Status Read once the user has opened the transaction.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t use Read as a disabled look — Disabled is a State value.

usageGuidelines.doText: Keep the label to one line inside its 172 px column.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t let a long counterparty name push the amount out of its 98 px column.

usageGuidelines.doText: Fill Leading-Slot with an Avatar or a merchant icon that identifies the counterparty.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t put a second text layer or a badge in the slot.

usageGuidelines.doText: Show one Skeleton row per expected transaction while the list loads.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t use Skeleton for a refresh of a single amount.

scorecard.notes: PascalCase frames, Leading-Slot / Trailing-Slot named slots, no offset frames — read on 5488:32979.
State and Status split, Title Case values, no absence-based names.
Label and Amount resolve to Primary/Headlines/Block, Date to Secondary/Bold/Caption. Colour variable bindings are not readable with the plugin — confirm in Dev Mode.
Two enums, two slots, four text values — maps 1:1 onto EBTransactionCard.
Default, Pressed and Disabled built; Read and Skeleton exist at State Default only.
Avatar and Badge are instances. The Trailing-Slot icon (Others) carries a shape_full BOOLEAN_OPERATION — flatten it in the icon library.

variants.description: 3 State × 3 Status, with Read and Skeleton built at State Default only = 5 variants

Cards follow Status — Default, Read, Skeleton — with State as a panel control; colours, text styles and the 82 / 79 heights read off 5488:32979, 5501:38441 and 5488:33001. Padding, gap, alignment and colour tokens are not readable with the plugin and stay —.

Code tab regrouped on the State × Status schema. Property Mapping is one row per property, Usage Snippets and Guidelines added, Scorecard regraded, Variants Inventory moved from the five type nodes to the five live nodes.
Trailing-Slot icon carries a BOOLEAN_OPERATION. The Others icon on 5488:32979 contains shape_full; flatten it in the icon library. Filed from the scorecard for the Component Review.

Resolved issues recorded. 11 resolved issues on the Overview tab had no changelog row: type enum replaced by slot-based composition; no amount and more information values retired; Heading weight aligned with Generic Card; Pressed and disabled states added; Axis split into State and Status; Slots brought onto the family convention; The three offset frames named, and the typo fixed; Legacy sigil dropped and frames moved to PascalCase; Label overflow resolved; Skeleton brought onto the shared vocabulary; Amount duplication resolved.
Verdict: Restructure — Replace type enum (5 layouts) with slot-based composition. Align heading weight with Generic Card. Add pressed state. Open
C1 — Type enum hides layouts — Same anti-pattern as Alert's Full Width. Split into leadingMedia, badge, trailing, loading. Open
C2 — Absence-based names — no amount / more information describe what's missing. Semantic slot names replace them. Open
C2 — Heading weight inconsistency — Semibold 600 vs Generic Card's Bold 700. Standardize across card family. Open
C5 — Pressed state — Transaction rows drill into detail on tap; needs tap feedback. Open
Skeleton pattern ✓ — First-class loading variant, matches Generic Card. Adopt as DS-wide convention. Noted
C7 — Code Connect — Blocked on restructure. Open
